dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Sombra is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Sombra has shown high arousal, including repeatedly jumping on handlers, grabbing at clothing, mouthiness, and persistent leash biting. He has also placed his open mouth on a handler's arm multiple times and has been difficult to redirect with treats or toys. Sombra is highly social with staff and volunteers but is struggling to acclimate. Medically, Sombra is apparently healthy.
dog.name: Sombra
